description: Source code for a LightningJS component named 'EditorPanel' that manages note editing, including saving, deleting, and regenerating summaries. It interacts with a store for state management and utilizes external modules for styling and summary generation.

classes.name: EditorPanel
classes.description: LightningJS component for editing notes, with functionality to save, delete, and regenerate summaries, and display note title, content, and summary.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes component state with the currently selected note from the store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current title and content to the store for the selected note.

methods.name: regenerateSummary
methods.description: Generates a new summary from the current content using the summarize utility.

methods.name: clearOrNew
methods.description: Clears the current note fields or creates a new empty note.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note from the store.
